title: Karpathy’s Pelican
author: delichon
relevanceReason: 命中 3 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: We're starting to leave the territory where you'd test an LLM by e.g. "create an svg of pelican on a bicycle". As one idea to generalize it, I was interested what Opus 5 would do if I gave it the first paragraph of the Lord of the Rings, a 1M token budget (~$10) and asked for three js render of it. Opus went off for ~2 hours and wrote 5500 lines of code that (procedurally) rendered the story. It's kind of janky but fun. But it's a bit mindboggling that the LLM has to place and orchestrate various polygon assets in (x,y,z) coordinates and write code that animates it all, and that it even does anything at all.

I also like this kind of examples because no one in their right mind would ever spend the time to write something this custom but LLMs have all the stamina and patience in the world, so it's an example where we go from "no one would ever do this" to "sure, why not, it's ~free". There might be a lot more. But I'm excited about creating hyper custom worlds that you can imagine dropping players into, e.g. here to participate in the LoTR story as a spectator NPC, or one of the characters, or etc. Something like an ephemeral GTA of X on demand.

Last thought is that the domain of worlds/games exposes a weakness in LLMs: they can't easily audit their work because they aren't able to efficiently and natively perceive videos or play games within them. Here, Opus 5 had to very slowly and painstakingly take screenshots at different points, and it messed up a few times and created a bunch of jank. An example of raw capability (multimodal, gameplay) that I think is still quite lacking.00:00

comments.author: jmugan
comments.textRawHtml: A lot of people are posting here about how bad the end product is, but that is kind of the point. Models have moved beyond generating images to a new kind of benchmark that better exposes understanding of the physical world, and we can use benchmarks like this to measure future progress. (Of course, it will have to be a qualitative/subjective measurement.)
comments.textZhHtml: 很多人都在这里发帖谈论最终产品有多糟糕，但这就是重点。模型已经超越了生成图像的范畴，发展成为一种新的基准，可以更好地揭示对物理世界的理解，我们可以使用这样的基准来衡量未来的进展。 （当然，它必须是定性/主观测量。）

children.author: maxutility
children.textRawHtml:
Agree. The pelican benchmark was interesting a year ago when most models struggled and a good pelican indicated an unusually capable model. Now it’s saturated and uninteresting.

A good new benchmark should have awful performance to start and there should be a lot of headroom for improvement. This benchmark is also intentionally difficult and requires the LLM to develop the animation through spatial reasoning and first principals rather than existing video generation pipelines. Similar to how SVG generation was out of distribution for most models a year ago.
children.textZhHtml:
同意。一年前，鹈鹕基准测试很有趣，当时大多数模型都在挣扎，而一个好的鹈鹕则表明了一个异常有能力的模型。现在它已经饱和并且无趣了。

一个好的新基准应该有糟糕的开始性能，并且应该有很大的改进空间。这个基准也故意设置了难度，要求法学硕士通过空间推理和第一原理而不是现有的视频生成管道来开发动画。类似于一年前 SVG 生成在大多数型号中不再发行的情况。

children.author: irthomasthomas
children.textRawHtml: I think it's interesting to see them visibly struggling to improve. Claude pelicans aren't much better today than they where 18 months.
children.textZhHtml: 我认为看到他们明显在努力提高是很有趣的。今天的克劳德鹈鹕并不比 18 个月前好多少。

children.author: aero142
children.textRawHtml: The code I see is a lot like the pelicans. All of the code in codebases, good, bad and ugly, is slowly being replaced by whatever level of code ai is currently able to create. All code is now a slightly wonky pelican on a bike, but if you look closely, it doesn’t fully make sense. Since ai is converging on less wonky, but not internally consistent, we’re just moving on to what is possible with high volume instead of detailed quality. I think that is the ai software world as well.
children.textZhHtml: 我看到的代码很像鹈鹕。代码库中的所有代码，无论好坏还是丑陋，都正在慢慢被人工智能当前能够创建的任何级别的代码所取代。所有代码现在都像是骑在自行车上的有点奇怪的鹈鹕，但如果你仔细观察，它并不完全有意义。由于人工智能正在趋于不那么不稳定，但内部不一致，所以我们只是继续研究高容量而不是详细质量的可能性。我认为这也是人工智能软件的世界。

children.author: saidnooneever
children.textRawHtml:
they are quite good also at placement and creating scenes etc. I had one implement a cascading shadow system in vulkan/glfw and just fed it back screenshots with peter pannin and acne spots etc.

it made a huge monstrosity first, 1500+ lines of shader code. Once it was happy with the result (it looked pretty good, almost blenders gamerenderer) it cleaned it up and a lot of debug code was removed. shrank it down to about 350 lines and made it much more readable.

this was something i didnt expect it to be able to do. create shaders, look at screenshots, fix em iteratively like that. multi modal debugging.
children.textZhHtml:
他们也非常擅长放置和创建场景等。我在 vulkan/glfw 中实现了一个级联阴影系统，然后将其反馈了带有 Peter Pannin 和痤疮斑点等的屏幕截图。

它首先造成了一个巨大的怪物，有 1500 多行着色器代码。一旦它对结果感到满意（它看起来相当不错，几乎是搅拌机游戏渲染器），它就会清理它并删除大量调试代码。将其缩减至约 350 行，并使其更具可读性。

这是我没想到它能够做到的事情。创建着色器，查看屏幕截图，像这样迭代修复它们。多模式调试。

children.author: sixtyj
children.textRawHtml:
Have you seen pelicans in Simon Willison’s tests? It is still not a pelican on bike I would like to publish :)

Imho we don’t need to make benchmarks that draw the whole 3D world. Pelican’s drawing is really nice in its simplicity and complexity at the same time.

It seems to be an obscene waste of compute time to generate useless 3D worlds that are just a bragging - 3D is really heavy discipline to make it right, see Mark Zuckerberg’s ceased attempt with 3D VR…

Multiply it by thousands times as a lot of people have found out threejs lib and prompt “generate 3D world and make no mistake” are new orange/black.
children.textZhHtml:
你在西蒙·威利森的测试中见过鹈鹕吗？它仍然不是我想发布的自行车上的鹈鹕:)

恕我直言，我们不需要制定绘制整个 3D 世界的基准。 Pelican 的绘图在简单性和复杂性方面都非常出色。

生成无用的 3D 世界只是一种吹牛，这似乎是对计算时间的极大浪费 - 3D 确实是一项严格的纪律，要使其正确，请参阅马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 停止对 3D VR 的尝试......

将其乘以数千倍，因为很多人已经发现了 Threejs lib 并提示“生成 3D 世界并不进行任何操作”。错误”是新的橙色/黑色。

children.author: monk_grilla
children.textRawHtml:
I don't know I think it is charming in a way that is lacking in nearly everything else an LLM tries to do creatively.

I have always preferred the result of getting an LLM to draw an svg or make a procedural animation like this to the uncanny hyper-realistic result of diffusion image/video generation.
children.textZhHtml:
我不知道我认为它的迷人之处是法学硕士尝试创造性地做的几乎所有其他事情都缺乏的。

我一直更喜欢让法学硕士绘制 svg 或制作这样的程序动画的结果，而不是扩散图像/视频生成的不可思议的超现实结果。

children.author: doginasuit
children.textRawHtml:
To help explain AI to my elderly mother, I said it is like an alien intelligence on a planet too far away to directly observe Earth, and everything it knows about humanity and our world it learned from reading just about every book and website. You can ask it a question or to do some work and it can often give a useful response but it can never directly judge its accuracy if it relates to the physical world, it has only your judgment to work with.

Given that limitation, it is incredible what it can still accomplish. And when it falls short, it is often in a charming way, if you are open to seeing it that way. It reflects something like a child's understanding of the world, not entirely wrong, just incomplete.

The fluttering cubes that might have been bees or butterflies were my favorite part.
children.textZhHtml:
为了帮助向我年迈的母亲解释人工智能，我说它就像一个距离太远而无法直接观察地球的行星上的外星智能体，它通过阅读几乎每一本书和网站了解到有关人类和我们世界的一切。你可以问它一个问题或做一些工作，它通常可以给出有用的响应，但如果它与物理世界相关，它永远无法直接判断其准确性，它只能根据你的判断进行工作。

考虑到这一限制，它仍然可以完成令人难以置信的事情。当它达不到要求时，它通常会以一种迷人的方式出现，如果你愿意以这种方式看待它的话。它反映了孩子对世界的理解，并非完全错误，只是不完整。

那些可能是蜜蜂或蝴蝶的飘动的立方体是我最喜欢的部分。

children.author: Valakas_
children.textRawHtml:
That's a nice metaphor for your mother, i like it. I would just touch on one small part, which is that it has more than our judgement though. It has access to laws of physics, to formulas, to all our current scientific knowledge which we have shown to be correct by interacting with the physical world. It can create an (incomplete) model of the world based on verified theories already. Through deduction and reasoning alone it can get pretty far. After all, there's many scientific theories we created long in advance before we actually proved them to be correct through interaction with the physical world. So even before they were proved to be correct, they were already correct. Same can be applied to what LLM can infer through reasoning alone.

Anyway, just a small point which probably still wouldn't change the nice metaphor your made.
children.textZhHtml:
这是对你母亲的一个很好的比喻，我喜欢它。我只想谈一小部分，那就是它的内容超出了我们的判断。它可以获取物理定律、公式以及我们当前所有的科学知识，这些知识通过与物理世界的互动而被证明是正确的。它可以根据已验证的理论创建一个（不完整的）世界模型。仅通过演绎和推理就可以走得很远。毕竟，我们在通过与物理世界的相互作用实际证明它们是正确的之前就已经提前创建了许多科学理论。因此，即使在它们被证明是正确的之前，它们就已经是正确的了。同样的情况也适用于法学硕士仅通过推理就能推断出的内容。

无论如何，这只是一个小点，可能仍然不会改变你所做的漂亮比喻。

children.author: doginasuit
children.textRawHtml: That's true, on some level it is capable of reasoning about the physical world even beyond our ability, through sheer breadth of knowledge and stamina. I suppose the area where it relies most on our judgment is about subjective experience, and this better explains its limitations.
children.textZhHtml: 确实如此，在某种程度上，它能够通过广博的知识和耐力来推理物理世界，甚至超出我们的能力。我想它最依赖我们判断的领域是主观经验，这更好地解释了它的局限性。
